They match the axial sampling levels of S4 under different contrast. The Cor description suffix is inconsistent with native axial anatomy; supplied Axial is supported.
Three transverse knee views agree with the Tra description and supplied Axial, with the same recognizable transverse levels as S6.

Six panels show paired femoral condyles across the knee width, broad tibial plateau and femur/tibia long axes through anterior-to-posterior coronal levels. Both rows agree with their Cor descriptions and official Coronal.

Nine panels show femoral/tibial side profiles, individual condylar contours, anterior patellar/extensor structures and posterior soft-tissue profiles. All three contrasts are anatomical sagittal views and agree with supplied Sagittal and Sag descriptions.
